definition.difference_from_m10: Earlier reset was before baseline; these reset branches are not direct replicas of earlier reset branches
definition.inference: Descriptive seed-paired bootstrap, 4000 resamples seed1234, per mapping/stage; no learning/significance gate
definition.interaction: weight effect under a gate minus weight effect under sham; paired/control weight-effect contrasts
definition.intervention: Core weights restored after identical neutral baseline, then gates applied immediately before action
definition.negative_control: If every changed edge is blocked, action traces must be identical between weight states
definition.state: Same cellular/refractory state and fixed visual count decoder; unblocked pending inputs retain emission amplitude; other pathways remain
definition.status: Exploratory crossed intervention on known M9 seeds; not fresh confirmation
definition.validation: Original M9 result and CSVs unchanged; all four trained branches reproduce archived M10-D; neutral LIF tolerance2e-5
